A spatial app is an application that can perceive the physical environment, understand spatial relationships, and present virtual content within it. Through immersive interaction and the fusion of virtual and real elements, users can experience and manipulate digital content in three-dimensional space in a natural and intuitive way. PICO Spatial SDK is a development toolkit specifically designed for building spatial apps.
## PICO Spatial SDK
PICO Spatial SDK is based on the Android framework and is specifically designed for developing spatial apps running on PICO OS 6. With the SDK, you can quickly build highly immersive spatial apps, enabling users to seamlessly switch between the physical and digital worlds or gain a brand-new immersive experience in scenarios where virtual and real elements are combined. The main capabilities provided by the SDK are as follows:

* **Scene building**: Supports creating complete spaces in virtual or mixed reality environments, covering 2D/3D content layout, rendering effect overlays, multimedia resource applications, and more.
* **Environmental perception**: Provides functions for understanding the surrounding physical environment and its changes, including spatial anchor, Spatial Mesh, plane detection, and more, allowing virtual content to naturally integrate with the real world.
* **Multimodal interaction**: Supports natural and intuitive interaction through multiple media such as eye tracking, hand pose, controller, keyboard, and more, enabling users to operate spatial apps in a more intuitive way.

## Spatial app
Spatial app is a new type of application running on PICO OS 6. It breaks the boundaries between traditional interfaces and spatial scenes, providing an infinite canvas that seamlessly integrates 2D elements, 3D elements, virtual scenes, and real spaces, offering users a highly immersive experience.
Within the overall framework of the spatial app, the spatial container is the most fundamental component. The app's lifecycle, state management, content presentation, and effect interaction all depend on the spatial container. PICO Spatial SDK provides two types of spatial containers: WindowContainer and Stage. You can place 2D components and 2D views directly in the spatial container, and place 3D content in the spatial container via SpatialView. On this basis, the ECS architecture is responsible for efficient data management and logical processing of entities and their components within the container, thereby driving dynamic updates and interaction logic for spatial content.

PICO OS 6 supports two space states: Shared Space and Full Space, meeting the different needs of daily multitasking and deeply immersive scenarios.
By default, various apps and containers are freely arranged in Shared Space, similar to the desktop of a PC system. The difference is that this "desktop" has been upgraded from a two-dimensional plane to a three-dimensional space, and the original desktop wallpaper has expanded from a single image to the user's surrounding real world or an immersive virtual environment. To gain greater control over the spatial environment or gain more access to perception features, you can let the app enter Full Space, allowing it to exclusively occupy the entire current space. This is similar to "full screen" in traditional systems, eliminating interference from other apps and granting comprehensive control over the spatial scene. For more information, refer to [Understanding spatial containers & space states](/learn-about-spatial-containers-and-space-states).

## Development tools
With the PICO Spatial SDK and supporting tools, whether you are a developer familiar with Android apps, a developer experienced in 3D apps or games, or a beginner just starting with spatial apps, you can easily get started with spatial app development.

* **PICO Spatial Plugin**: PICO Spatial Plugin is an all-in-one spatial app development plugin based on Android Studio, providing developers with a complete spatial app development toolchain. For details, see [What is PICO Spatial Plugin](/document/spatial-toolkit/learn-about-spatial-plugin/).
   ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c0dc73f77140431f9f05ce55a0864957~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
* **PICO Spatial Editor**: PICO Spatial Editor is a visual editor for 3D scenes that supports importing and exporting Universal Scene Description (USD) assets, and offers asset editing, component configuration, scene construction, effect preview, and other features. For details, see [What is PICO Spatial Editor](/document/spatial-toolkit/know-spatial-editor/).
   ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/97ab8581d7ab4f8f9b26e00de0a5afcc~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
* **PICO Emulator**: PICO Emulator allows you to quickly preview the application's running effect, perform debugging, and improve development efficiency without using a physical device. For more details, refer to [What is PICO Emulator](/document/spatial-toolkit/learn-about-pico-emulator/).
   ![Image](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e99d05a88699441d87748f7a45525294~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image)
